name: build-character-walking-animation-pipeline
description: A provider-neutral, approval-gated character walking animation pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Build approved character walk sprites from anchors and user-made video.
interface.longDescription: Guides a character from a south anchor through directional review, manual video generation, semantic keyframe selection, optional pixel snap, and runtime export.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $build-character-walking-animation-pipeline to build or resume a character walking animation.
